description: Dependency updates for the whole monorepo (uv, pnpm, Dockerfiles, compose, GitHub Actions, SwiftPM).
One weekly batch per ecosystem for minor/patch moves; majors are separate PRs (GitHub Actions excepted),
and runtime bumps (Python, Node, Postgres, TypeScript majors) wait for a Dependency Dashboard tick.
Releases must be 3 days old before they are proposed (vulnerability fixes excepted).
The hosted app cannot run postUpgradeTasks: .github/workflows/renovate-regen.yml regenerates
openapi.json + frontend/src/client (make client) and ios/QuickrKit/Package.resolved on renovate/* branches.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Backend: one weekly PR for minor/patch moves (what the Dependabot `python` group did). Majors stay separate.
Frontend: one weekly PR for minor/patch moves (the Dependabot `npm` group). Majors stay separate.
The hey-api generator rewrites frontend/src/client, so keep it out of the npm batch: its PR carries the regenerated client (renovate-regen.yml) and is reviewed on its own.
Workflows: one weekly PR, majors included (an action major is usually its Node runtime). Digests stay pinned with the `# vX.Y.Z` comment (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests).

Base images in the Dockerfiles and compose files: one weekly PR for minor/patch moves; majors separate. Tags, not digests: the images are multi-arch and rebuilt locally by compose; a digest pin would add a weekly PR per image for no reproducibility we rely on.
SwiftPM (GRDB): one weekly PR for minor/patch moves. Package.swift moves here; renovate-regen.yml refreshes Package.resolved on a macOS runner.

Python is pinned to 3.14 (pyproject requires-python, uv.lock, ruff target, Dockerfile). A 3.15 move needs all of them plus wheel coverage, so it waits for a tick on the Dependency Dashboard. 3.14.x patches flow normally.
A Node major moves .nvmrc, the frontend Dockerfile and @types/node together; opt in from the Dependency Dashboard.
A Postgres major (compose and the CI service) needs the hosted data volume upgraded first; opt in from the Dependency Dashboard.
TypeScript 7 ships only the native tsc: @hey-api/openapi-ts needs the JS compiler API and typescript-eslint pins typescript <6.1 (see #116). Opt in from the Dependency Dashboard once both support it.
